correctness.rationale: Each of the 4+6d plane sections is a smooth irreducible Fermat-type plane curve when d>=4 is even; their rank-two line-flat classes have counts 6,4d^2,12d,3d^2 with  d+2,3,2,2 incident planes. Restriction of sum(x_i^d) to each flat is a s^d+b t^d with positive integer coefficients, hence has d simple zeros over C. Three independent reflection hyperplanes force all nonzero coordinates in a single root-of-unity component, giving F_d=r c^d !=0, so no rank-three flat lies on S_d. Consequently ordinary basket: 6d points of multiplicity d+2, 4d^3 ordinary triple points and (12d^2+3d^3) nodes; total 7d^3+12d^2+6d; delta=18d^3+21d^2+6d; adjunction genus 21d^3+14d^2+1. The independently rebuilt Gaussian-rational d=4 line lattice has 6,64,96 flats with 6,3,2 hyperplanes and symbolic general-d counts/checks agree. Finite quartic census is corroboration; unrestricted theorem rests on exhaustive support/flat argument and transversality.
